patch_description: Remove the eight RX gates tied to `crz_center`, while leaving an explicit explanatory comment so the replacement is non-empty. The stronger prior result used the same two shared CRZ bridges and final RY conversion without this RX layer, reaching 0.96 validation accuracy versus the current 0.94. Tying a global RX basis change to a controlled-phase parameter forces one variable to optimize incompatible functions, worsening conditioning and disrupting the final phase-to-population conversion. This edit keeps four parameters per block and 26 parameters overall, but lowers depth and gate count.
